---
title: "Figures"
---

Figure scripts read the aggregated results under `<DATA_ROOT>/data/outputs/` and write
to `50_plots/`. None of them fit a model, so they run in seconds to minutes.

| Script | Produces | Reads |
|--------|----------|-------|
| `51_fig-1_worldmap_mat_map_era5.py` | Figure 1, site map with ERA5 climate normals | `10_datasets/17_..._era5.csv` |
| `52_fig-2+ExtFig_flameplots.py` | Figure 2 and the matching Extended Data figures, binned SHAP heatmaps | `40_aggregation/` |
| `53_fig-3_sankeyplot_shapvalues_8stages.py` | Figure 3, SHAP flow across the stress stages | `40_aggregation/` |
| `54_fig-4_vpd_response_curve_shap_agg.py` | Figure 4, VPD response curve from SHAP with threshold | `40_aggregation/` |
| `55_fig_ale_response_curve_with_context.py` | ALE response curves with consensus threshold | `30_shap/<flux>/ale/` |
| `56_ExtDataFig1+Table1_scenarios_boxplot_shapsums.py` | Extended Data Figure 1 and Table 1 | `40_aggregation/` |

## Figure 4: which values are averaged

`54_fig-4_vpd_response_curve_shap_agg.py` sets `aggfunc = 'mean'`. That is what the SHAP
values are aggregated with, matching the manuscript.

The script also sets `median` for two columns, which is easy to misread as median
aggregation of the results:

```python
# Bins always use 'median', b/c using 'mean' results in floating point errors
xagg = 'median' if str(xvar).startswith('BIN_') else aggfunc
yagg = 'median' if str(xvar).startswith('BIN_') else aggfunc
xcol, ycol, zcol = (f"{xvar}", xagg), (f"{yvar}", yagg), (f"{zvar}", aggfunc)
```

`xagg` and `yagg` apply to the bin coordinate columns only. Every record in a bin
carries the same bin edge, so mean and median return the same number, and the median is
used because averaging identical floats reintroduces rounding noise in the labels. The
SHAP values themselves, `zcol`, use `aggfunc`.

## Script 55: configuration

The ALE response curve script is the most configurable of the six. Options at the top of
the file:

| Setting | Default | Effect |
|---------|---------|--------|
| `PLOT_FEATURE` | `VPD_ZSCORE` | Feature on the x axis |
| `FLUX` | `NEP_ZSCORE` | Target |
| `USE_MEDIAN` | `False` | Mean aggregation across sites; `True` switches to median |
| `USE_CI` | `True` | 95 % percentile band; `False` shows the standard error |
| `FAST_TEST_MODE` | `False` | Runs on five random sites, useful before a full pass |

Output is one panel with all site curves in grey behind the aggregated curve and its
percentile band, a marker at the consensus zero crossing, and four panels splitting the
same data by IGBP type (ENF, DBF, MF, EBF). Per-site PNGs and a CSV with the threshold
statistics are written alongside.
